infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ParkEasy requires camera access to scan parking ticket QR codes and user profile QR codes.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ParkEasy requires location access to find nearby parking sites and calculate distance.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow ParkEasy to use your camera to scan ticket and wallet QR codes.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow ParkEasy to use your location to search for nearby parking spaces.
